findings.message: 1 frame in the middle of a stream holds an Info header, probably where files were joined; players that only look at the first frame play it as silence. The first at 0x7E0.
The stream changes from MPEG-1 Layer III, 48000 Hz to MPEG-1 Layer III, 44100 Hz at 0x7E0.
